sens_en: to found, to make an offering
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 奠 par « poser l'offrande » : 酋, la jarre de vin, sur son support. On lit 丷 et 酉 en haut, et dessous 大, qui a pris la place du support. De l'offrande posée vient « fonder », poser les bases.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 奠 as “to set down an offering”: 酋, the wine jar, on its stand. You read 丷 and 酉 on top, and below them 大, which has taken the place of the stand. From setting down the offering comes “to found”, to lay the groundwork.
